## Disclaimers

+ Good writing cannot save a bad idea, but could make it harder to
  reject.
  
+ Poor writing can damage great ideas.

+ Writing is a learnable skill; Practice makes perfection.

+ Every specific tip means one less mistake or poor style

+ AI era: you need to know how to evaluate AI writings and form your
  own styles.
